title: Fuzzy Win-Win: A Novel Approach to Quantify Win-Win Using Fuzzy Logic
reasoning: The paper proposes a mathematical model based on fuzzy logic to quantify the outcomes of negotiations. While it deals with concepts like fairness in a negotiation, it does so from a quantitative, game-theoretic perspective rather than a moral, ethical, or religious one. The goal is to calculate winning percentages based on economic variables, not to evaluate the ethical dimensions of the negotiation.
